title: Define normative relationship-conditioned human-decision policy
goal: Create a reviewable policy and schema that make AI-human relationship history the contextual root of the decision tree without allowing relationship history, trust, quorum, reputation, or adaptation to create unauthorized execution authority over human-impacting actions.

validation.required_next_event: A repository maintainer approves or manually dispatches RCE P0-001 Validation; the run executes successfully and its receipt artifact is preserved

acceptance_criteria: schema validation passes for the canonical example
implicit authority inferred from trust fails closed
self-sacrificial or irreversible human-impacting execution is never returned as autonomous ALLOW
advisory, witness, guardian, delegate, and counterparty roles have distinct bounded outputs
unknown or conflicting authority returns ABSTAIN, ESCALATE, or FAIL_CLOSED
tests preserve non-guarantee and temporal-identity disclosures without treating them as consent substitutes
blocked_by: repository approval or manual dispatch required for authoritative workflow
next_task_candidate: RCE-P0-002 canonical manifest and sandbox fixture package
prohibited_scope: autonomous execution of human self-harm or self-sacrifice
production ingestion of prior conversation ZIPs
authority inferred solely from trust or history
operational targeting instructions or autonomous weapons enablement
